known_before_run: non-blind: the flow_24/flow_32 values and their quadratic structure are known; the direction is a selected line (max-min of the flow_24/flow_32 predictions); see the prerun note for the lattice-commensurability confound
prohibitions: no result of this run alone supports a GRID-01 amendment
no automatic resubmission or repair after an integrity failure
flow_48 only by a separate reviewed freeze after an AMBIGUOUS flow_40 verdict

rules.integrity: phi hashes byte-identical to the OPT-01 Stage B inventory; retained flow_24/flow_32 force CSVs hash-checked against the Stage B analysis; a plain fresh parent run (no cross-grid byte identity exists)
rules.quantity: G_max = max(0, sup over s in (0, 1.25] mm of a*s + b*s^2), the no-intercept least-squares fit of the downforce change on the five-state steps (+0.3125, +0.625, +1.25, -1.25 mm)
rules.question: do finer grids follow flow_32 (a positive slope capability along the OPT-01 direction) or flow_24 (none)?
rules.report_only: forward-only fit, contraction ratios and CONTRACTING/THIRD_VALUE labels, acceptance emulation per tested step, drag a and b per grid
rules.verdict: FLOW40_SIDES_WITH_FLOW32 iff G_max(flow_40) > 4e-5 N; FLOW40_SIDES_WITH_FLOW24 iff G_max < 2e-5 N; AMBIGUOUS otherwise (then the flow_48 branch, frozen and reviewed separately); INCOMPLETE on an integrity failure or any downforce fit residual above 2e-5 N on any of flow_24, flow_32, flow_40
